acceptanceCriteria: `go test -json` per-test timings for internal/cem/workflow retained before and after in a build-log entry; the slowest cases identified with their cause (repeated git setup, fixture rebuilds, sleeps, serial subprocesses).
Package wall time reduced by at least 50% on the same host load class without dropping assertions; shared fixtures built once per package where safe; t.Parallel where isolation allows.
Focused tests green; no test removed without a recorded equivalent.
body: Observed 2026-10-21 by the cem lane (PR #1410): `go test ./internal/cem/workflow` took 228 s via heavy.sh on a host at load 40-60. Every CEM lane and the full gate pay this. Owner rule 2026-10-21: every slow Corvint process gets speed-up work.

title: internal/cem/workflow tests take 228 s per run; profile and cut the slowest cases so lanes and gates stop paying it
